## Deploy USM Agent Command Handler with autoGenerated TLS certs

The Command Handler manages the Connect cluster `connect`, whose REST API is served over TLS with auto-generated certificates. Its REST endpoint and group.id are discovered from the Connect CR.

### Pre-requisite
- Deploy Confluent For Kubernetes (CFK) Operator. The Command Handler needs CFK 3.4.0 and USM Agent 1.3.0 or later.
```
helm upgrade --install confluent-operator confluentinc/confluent-for-kubernetes --namespace confluent
```

```
export TUTORIAL_HOME=<Tutorial directory>/hybrid/usmagent/command_handler/tls_autogen
```

### Generate ccloud secret. Please update the usm-ccloud.txt file with your credentials before running the command
```
kubectl create secret generic usm-ccloud-cred --from-file=basic.txt=$TUTORIAL_HOME/usm-ccloud.txt -n confluent
```

### Provide a Certificate Authority
Confluent For Kubernetes provides auto-generated certificates for the Confluent Platform components, the USM Agent and the Connect REST API. You'll need to generate and provide a Certificate Authority (CA).

Generate a CA pair to use:
```
openssl genrsa -out $TUTORIAL_HOME/ca-key.pem 2048

openssl req -new -key $TUTORIAL_HOME/ca-key.pem -x509 \
  -days 1000 \
  -out $TUTORIAL_HOME/ca.pem \
  -subj "/C=US/ST=CA/L=MountainView/O=Confluent/OU=Operator/CN=TestCA"
```

Create a Kubernetes secret for the certificate authority:
```
kubectl create secret tls ca-pair-sslcerts \
  --cert=$TUTORIAL_HOME/ca.pem \
  --key=$TUTORIAL_HOME/ca-key.pem -n confluent
```

### Deploy Confluent Platform
```
kubectl apply -f $TUTORIAL_HOME/confluent_platform.yaml
```

### Create the CA secret for the Command Handler
The Command Handler only needs the CA of the Connect certificate. Once Connect has generated its certificates, copy the CA into a secret of its own, under `cacerts.pem`.
```
kubectl get secret connect-generated-jks -n confluent -o jsonpath='{.data.ca\.crt}' | base64 -d > $TUTORIAL_HOME/connect-ca.pem

kubectl create secret generic connect-ca \
  --from-file=cacerts.pem=$TUTORIAL_HOME/connect-ca.pem \
  --namespace confluent
```

### Deploy USM Agent
```
kubectl apply -f $TUTORIAL_HOME/usmagent.yaml
```

### Create Kafka topic
```
kubectl apply -f $TUTORIAL_HOME/kafkatopic.yaml
```

### Create Connector
```
kubectl apply -f $TUTORIAL_HOME/connector.yaml
```
